_status: by the agent, 2026-11-19 — corrected from users' reports (GitHub issues, LANG-02)
r4_suhuf: Launukan abubuwan da aka fara tattara Alƙur'ani a kansu: karan dabino da siraran farin duwatsu, da tawada mai duhu. Mafi natsuwar zaɓi don dogon karatu.
r4_hira: Baƙin dutsen tsauni, da hasken farko na safiya a kogon da wahayi ya fara.
r4_ghar: Daren hijira a hamada: dutse da yashi, da sararin dare mai shuɗi mai zurfi a saman kogon.
r4_taybah: Taiba — ɗaya daga cikin sunayen Madina: dogayen bishiyoyin dabinonta, dabinonta, gidajenta na farko na laka.
r4_uhud: Jan dutsen Uhudu ƙarƙashin sararin Madina.
r4_ibil: Launuka huɗu daga ayoyi huɗu masu jere: raƙuma, sama, duwatsu, ƙasa.
r4_fajr: Lokacin alfijir: shuɗin ƙarshen dare, da ruwan hoda na hasken farko.
r4_duha: Rantsuwa biyu, jigo biyu: jigon rana daga aya ta farko, na dare daga ta biyu.
r4_ghaith: Ruwan sama da ƙasa mai kore bayansa: shuɗi-toka na gajimare, koren ciyawa.
r4_jannatan: Lambuna biyu na azurfa, kwanonsu da abin da ke cikinsu (Sahih al-Bukhari 4878): kore mai duhu, maɓuɓɓugai biyu masu bulbula, dabino da rumman.
r4_nur: Hasken fitila a cikin gilashinta, manta, da tauraro mai haske — kalmomi daga ayar haske.
r4_tin: Koren zaitun da shunayyar ɓaure — daga aya ta farko ta Suratut Tin.
r4_kawthar: Kogi wanda gaɓarsa kubbobi ne na lu'ulu'u mai rami (Sahih al-Bukhari 4964), ruwansa ya fi madara fari.
r4_qamar: Rantsuwa biyu: jigon rana daga rana, jigon dare daga wata — ayoyi biyu na farko na Suratush Shams.
r4_dhariyat: Tuddan yashi da layukan iska — daga aya ta farko ta Suratuz Zariyat.
r4_zar: Koren tsiro da zinariyar zangarniya — daga aya ta ƙarshe ta Suratul Fath.
r4_mara: Kalmomi biyu na launi a Suratul A'la: makiyaya kore da rana, launi mai duhu da dare.
r4_shajara: Itace mai kyau ita ce dabino (Sahih al-Bukhari 4698; as-Sa'di, Ibn Kathir): saiwarta tabbatacciya, rassanta a sama, tana 'ya'ya a kowane lokaci.
r4_tayr: Tsuntsaye a samansu, a Suratul Mulk: shuɗin sama a kan fili.
r4_zill: Inuwar da aka shimfiɗa: lokaci tsakanin alfijir da fitowar rana (Ibn Kathir, as-Sa'di), rana kuma mai nuni gare ta.
r4_fulk: Jiragen ruwa da aka ɗaga a teku kamar duwatsu — Suratur Rahman: shuɗin teku da filafilai masu tsayi kamar duwatsu.
r4_asr: Al-Asr: zamani — dare da rana (as-Sa'di, Ibn Kathir): rana tana komawa dare.
r4_mamdud: Magaryar da ba ta da ƙaya, itatuwan talh masu jerin 'ya'ya, inuwa mai faɗi (56:28–30); itacen da mahayi ke tafiya a inuwarsa shekara ɗari (Sahih al-Bukhari 4881).
r4_anhar: Koguna huɗu na 47:15: ruwa, madara, abin sha da zuma, suna gudana daga sama.
r4_ghuraf: Gidaje masu hawa ɗaya bisa ɗaya, koguna na gudana ƙarƙashinsu (39:20).
r4_khiyam: Tanti na lu'ulu'u guda mai rami (Sahih al-Bukhari 4879, Muslim 2838); kalmar al-khiyam (55:72).
